messages:
deploy-bot: kicking off rollout rl-2026-03-29-05 canary=10% -> scheduled step to 40% in 10m
maya: quick check — eu-west synth p95 for /generate jumped from ~140ms to ~270ms, responses still 200s
ryan: pulling gateway traces and auth-proxy logs now
priya: release notes show routing.preference_local=true and a conn-pool tweak, nothing auth-specific in notes
maya: no 5xxs, just higher tail and a small auth-kv miss uptick on probes
triage-bot: INC-2026-073 created - postdeploy synth latency aberration
ryan: recommend pausing the ramp and pinning /generate to previous variant v2.2.0 while we triage
maya: +1 pause and pin
priya: agree, prefer to keep canary small while we confirm root cause
ryan: sample pin call:
```
POST /admin/routing/pin
{ "route": "/generate", "variant": "v2.2.0" }
```
ryan: applied pin at 4755009220 (actor: ryan) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: routing pin applied for /generate -> v2.2.0
ops-bot: smoke-probe (post-pin) -> p95=150ms p99=205ms status=ok
maya: looks like pin brought latency back near baseline, leaving canary at 10% for a 20m stability window
priya: filing follow-up RFC-2026-159 to evaluate header prefetch, small local cache, and a micro-synthetic that hits auth-heavy paths prior to routing changes
ryan: changelog note: "pinned /generate to v2.2.0 due to auth-KV miss spike correlated with routing.preference_local; investigating (RFC-2026-159)"
triage-bot: INC-2026-073 marked monitoring; awaiting stable window
maya: retrospective item: add auth-path synthetic to preflight checklist and a short perf test toggling preference_local under load
ryan: will keep an eye on tails, reopen thread if noise returns
maya: thanks all, keeping this thread open until clear
